verdict.rationale: Gazebo's user-facing data (worlds and models) are SDFormat files that users edit directly. Example worlds can be freely copied and modified, and Fuel models expose copyable SDF snippets, which gives some native portability through a parseable format. There is no documented export-all mechanism, and the evidence never states that the formats are open or covers leaving the product. Missing for 10: an explicit bulk export of all user data (worlds, logs, Fuel assets), documentation that SDFormat and other data formats are open standards, and independent corroboration of portability.
